clarifications.title: Tax Returns
clarifications.clarification: When formal business tax returns are unavailable, immigration authorities may accept alternative evidence that clearly demonstrates business income amount, source, and continuity over time.

secondary_evidence.label: CPA or accountant income summary letter
secondary_evidence.description: Must be prepared by a licensed accountant or tax professional.
should_state: Total business income earned over the past 12 months
requirements: The letter should be signed, dated, and issued on professional letterhead.
Supporting financial documents may still be requested.

secondary_evidence.label: Year-end financial statements
secondary_evidence.description: Annual financial summaries prepared by an accountant or accounting system.
notes: Self-generated statements without professional verification may require additional review.

secondary_evidence.label: Business bank statements showing revenue
secondary_evidence.description: Bank statements from business accounts showing consistent revenue deposits.
must_include: Monthly revenue deposits totaling minimum income requirement
notes: Statements should clearly distinguish business revenue from personal transfers or loans.

clarifications.title: Profit & Loss Statements
clarifications.clarification: When formal profit and loss statements are unavailable, immigration authorities may accept alternative evidence that demonstrates business profitability and income stability.

secondary_evidence.label: Accountant-prepared financial summaries
secondary_evidence.description: Financial summaries or reports prepared by a licensed accountant.
should_state: Monthly or quarterly revenue and expenses
requirements: Must be signed and dated by the accountant on professional letterhead.

secondary_evidence.label: Business bank statements
secondary_evidence.description: Bank statements showing consistent business income deposits minus expenses.
must_clearly_show: Net positive cash flow meeting minimum income requirement
notes: Statements covering 12 months strengthen proof of income stability.

secondary_evidence.label: Accounting software reports
secondary_evidence.description: P&L reports generated from recognized accounting platforms (QuickBooks, Xero, etc.).
notes: Reports should include platform branding or export certification.

clarifications.title: Bank Statements
clarifications.clarification: When business bank statements are unavailable or incomplete, immigration authorities may accept alternative evidence that demonstrates consistent business income deposits over the required time period.

secondary_evidence.label: Payment processor statements
secondary_evidence.description: Transaction records from payment platforms (Stripe, PayPal, Square, etc.) showing business revenue.
must_include: Monthly revenue totals meeting minimum income requirement
notes: Screenshots should include platform branding and business name verification.

secondary_evidence.label: Accountant-verified income confirmation
secondary_evidence.description: Written confirmation from a licensed accountant verifying business income deposits.
should_state: Monthly business income over the past 12 months
Source and method of income verification
Confirmation that income meets minimum threshold
requirements: Must be signed and dated by licensed accountant on professional letterhead.
Accountant must confirm they have reviewed underlying financial records.

clarifications.title: Income Duration — 12-Month Requirement
clarifications.clarification: Costa Rica's Digital Nomad visa requires proof of stable business income for at least 12 consecutive months. If you can only provide documentation for fewer months, additional evidence may be required.

secondary_evidence.label: Extended business bank statements
secondary_evidence.description: Bank statements from business accounts covering the full 12-month period.
should_state: Consistent monthly revenue deposits meeting minimum income requirement

secondary_evidence.label: Accountant confirmation of income duration
secondary_evidence.description: Written confirmation from a licensed accountant verifying duration of business income.
should_state: Confirmation of consistent income generation over specified period
requirements: Signed and dated by licensed accountant on professional letterhead

secondary_evidence.label: Business registration with supporting financial records
secondary_evidence.description: Official business registration documents combined with financial evidence showing operational history.
must_include: Business registration date proving 12+ months of operation
Supporting financial records (bank statements, tax filings, etc.)

clarifications.title: Income Amount — Minimum Monthly Income
clarifications.clarification: Costa Rica's Digital Nomad program requires a minimum level of monthly business income. Based on your answer, the amount reported does not meet the minimum threshold for your selected category.
what_to_do: Recheck your monthly business income figure and currency conversion (use a consistent monthly average).
If business income fluctuates seasonally, calculate a conservative 12-month average.
If the amount is accurate, you may not qualify under the minimum income requirement.

clarifications.title: Foreign Income — Business Revenue Must Be Earned Outside Costa Rica
clarifications.clarification: For this visa category, qualifying income must be earned from business activities outside Costa Rica. Your responses indicate the income source does not meet this requirement.
what_to_do: Confirm that the revenue supporting your application is earned from clients or customers outside Costa Rica.
If revenue is mixed (both Costa Rican and foreign sources), you may need to demonstrate that qualifying foreign-sourced income meets the minimum threshold.
Provide documentation clearly showing the geographic source of your business revenue.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity — Expiration Window
clarifications.clarification: Applicants must hold a passport that remains valid beyond a minimum time window. Your passport expiration date appears too soon to satisfy this requirement.
what_to_do: Re-run the eligibility check after updating the expiration date.
